Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Row i uses zero-based row index i=0..n-1 and contains i+1 tokens. Token j is 1 when i+j is even and 0 otherwise. Separate tokens by one space.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    4
  ],
  "expected": [
    "1",
    "0 1",
    "1 0 1",
    "0 1 0 1"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    0
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Use the parity of row plus column.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises

solutions.name: binary-triangle.py
solutions.code:
def solve(n):
    return [' '.join('1' if (i+j)%2==0 else '0' for j in range(i+1)) for i in range(n)]
